caption: The drawing depicts a square area outlined faintly in pencil, occupying the upper left section of a plain, off-white or light beige background. Within the lower right corner of this square, there is a decorative border pattern composed of red floral motifs. The border runs along the right and bottom edges of the square, forming a scalloped edge with rounded and pointed curves. The floral motifs vary in size and consist of small flowers and branching stems, all rendered in red lines and shapes. The interior space of the pattern is sparsely filled with small isolated red flowers, while the denser clusters of flowers and leaves are concentrated along the scalloped edge. There are no additional objects, figures, or colors present in the composition aside from the pale background. In the lower right corner, outside the outlined square, there is a small handwritten inscription.
title: Handkerchief
